name: Rainbow Falls
where: Great Smoky Mountains National Park, Cherokee Orchard Road and Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail above Gatlinburg, Tennessee
blurb: A rocky climb beside Le Conte Creek to 80-foot Rainbow Falls, the park's highest single drop, with Grotto Falls and the heath bald on Brushy Mountain from the nearby Trillium Gap trailhead.
status: Open; parking tag required ($5/day). Roaring Fork Motor Nature Trail (Grotto Falls trailhead) closes for winter after November 29, 2026; Rainbow Falls is reached by Cherokee Orchard Road.
